parameters.query: =SELECT co.id, co.source, co.external_ref, co.location_key, co.order_type, co.status, co.customer, co.items, co.payment, co.vat_lines, co.correlation_id, co.ls_order_id, co.ls_customer_id, COALESCE(dl.is_active, true) AS location_active, COALESCE(dl.deliverect_active, false) AS deliverect_active, dl.delivery_plu, ro.raw_payload->>'restaurant_estimated_delivery_time' AS raw_est_delivery, ro.raw_payload->>'restaurant_estimated_pickup_time' AS raw_est_pickup, ro.raw_payload->'note_attributes' AS raw_note_attributes, COALESCE((  co.external_ref ILIKE '%TEST%'   OR EXISTS (    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(co.items) AS i(v)     WHERE (v->>'name') ILIKE '%TEST%'        OR (v->>'name') ILIKE '%NIET BEREIDEN%'        OR (v->>'plu')  ILIKE 'SHOP-%'  )), false) AS is_test_order FROM canonical_orders co LEFT JOIN dim_location dl ON dl.location_key = co.location_key LEFT JOIN raw_orders ro ON ro.id = co.raw_payload_id WHERE co.id = '{{ $json.canonical_id }}'::uuid;
=SELECT lightspeed_company_id, ls_table_ids, payment_type_ids FROM dim_location WHERE location_key = '{{ $json.location_key }}';
=SELECT access_token FROM ls_tokens WHERE location_key = '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.location_key }}';
=UPDATE canonical_orders SET status = 'pushing_ls' WHERE id = '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.id }}'::uuid AND status IN ('normalized', 'ls_failed') RETURNING id;

=SELECT r.sku, r.price
FROM public.raw_ls_products r
WHERE r.location_key = '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.location_key }}'
  AND r.visible = true
  AND r.sku IS NOT NULL AND r.sku <> ''
  AND r.sku = ANY(
    ARRAY(
      SELECT DISTINCT plu FROM (
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements(co.items)->>'plu' AS plu
        FROM public.canonical_orders co
        WHERE co.id IN ({{ $('Load Canonical Order').all().map(o => "'" + o.json.id + "'::uuid").join(',') }})
        UNION ALL
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_array_elements(co.items)->'modifiers')->>'plu'
        FROM public.canonical_orders co
        WHERE co.id IN ({{ $('Load Canonical Order').all().map(o => "'" + o.json.id + "'::uuid").join(',') }})
      ) AS all_plus
      WHERE plu IS NOT NULL AND plu <> ''
    )
  );

=INSERT INTO public.order_state_history (canonical_order_id, from_state, to_state, reason, correlation_id) VALUES ('{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.id }}'::uuid, '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.status }}'::order_state, '{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.status }}'::order_state, 'location_paused', NULLIF('{{ $('Load Canonical Order').item.json.correlation_id }}', '')::uuid);
